prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity design comparison board A for a real Brazilian mobile volleyball replay app named "Outro Ângulo". Landscape board containing EXACTLY THREE full portrait mobile app screens, front-on, 390:844 aspect each, same size and equally spaced, no perspective, no phone hardware, no ornamental background. Tiny board heading "A — Essencial". The screens are: Início, Partida, Revisão. All core UI is in Brazilian Portuguese. World: warm white #F7F7F2, graphite #17212B, clean cobalt #2456D8 used only for actions; white surfaces; sober native sans type, generous padding, great 48px touch targets. No gradients, glows, fake charts, neon, pills everywhere, wood textures or technical telemetry. A small original two-framing-corners symbol next to Outro Ângulo. COMPOSITION A is editorial and open, uses strong type and plain rows rather than stacks of cards.
Screen 1: white warm background, small logo at top, large left aligned title "Todo lance merece outro ângulo." A quiet geometric volleyball court diagram in the middle, not a photo. Explanatory text "Reveja o jogo com dois celulares." Bottom sport segmented control "Quadra" selected, "Praia". Solid cobalt primary "Criar partida", outlined secondary "Entrar como câmera". Footnote "Na mesma rede. Sem precisar de internet."
Screen 2: white warm background, small back navigation then title "Partida pronta". Secondary "Vôlei de quadra". Main region is a simple flat blue/white court schematic with two numbered camera pins 1 and 2 outside baseline, no weird decoration. Below a clean two-row camera list "1 · Este celular" / "2 · Câmera de fundo", each status "Gravando". Readiness line "40 s disponíveis". Bottom broad blue action "Revisar lance", quiet "Encerrar partida". Keep actions within safe area.
Screen 3: DARK #15191F replay UI, white type. Header back chevron and "Revisar lance". A large 4:3 photoreal amateur volleyball video still on an indoor court is the focal content, no graphics over video except unobtrusive camera label. Camera selector under it "Câmera 1" selected and "Câmera 2". Wide timeline with readable "00:24 / 00:40", big playback controls, "0,5×" speed, "Ajustar sincronia". Bottom primary "Retomar partida". Actual native UI mockup, not a poster. Consistent refined typography, restrained 12px radii, no marketing statistics or paid tiers. Show every screen fully, no cropped bottoms.
approval: User selected A — Essencial in this task
